arguments.sql: SELECT mc.mcc AS mcc, mc.description AS description, COUNT(t.id) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes mc ON m.mcc = mc.mcc WHERE mc.description = 'Passenger Railways' GROUP BY mc.mcc, mc.description ORDER BY mc.mcc
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions at merchants whose MCC is described as 'Passenger Railways', broken down by MCC code.
assumptions: Counts every transaction, labelled or not, since the question asks for a transaction count rather than a fraud rate.
Matches the description 'Passenger Railways' exactly, case-sensitive, as stored in mcc_codes.
Includes negative-amount transactions in the count, since no filter on amount was requested.
Covers the full date range of the data, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
